<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_WorkLiveAustria" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/work-live-austria">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_WorkLiveAustria" name="Work and Live in Austria" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_1" name="Process started">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_01</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_CheckRequirements" name="Check requirements for working and living in Austria">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_01</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_02</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Living_Split" name="Split: living arrangements" gatewayDirection="Diverging">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_02</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_03</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_04</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_Accommodation" name="Organize accommodation (negotiation)">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_03</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_05</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_BankAccount" name="Organize bank account (negotiation)">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_04</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_06</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Living_Join" name="Join: living arrangements" gatewayDirection="Converging">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_05</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_06</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_07</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_VisaType_Split" name="Visa type?" gatewayDirection="Diverging">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_07</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_08</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_09</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_10</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_TypeD" name="Determine competent Austrian representation (type D visa)">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_08</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_11</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_CategoryAC" name="Determine representation in consular district of legal residence (category A or C visa)">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_09</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_12</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_Schengen" name="Determine representation of main travel destination (Schengen visa)">
      <bpmn:documentation>If no main travel destination can be determined, the first Schengen entry member state is responsible.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_10</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_13</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Office_Merge" name="Competent office determined" gatewayDirection="Converging">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_11</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_12</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_13</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_14</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ContactRepresentation" name="Contact representation in advance for more information">
      <bpmn:documentation>Representation offices are listed on the website of the Federal Ministry of European and International Affairs (BMEIA).</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_14</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_15</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Docs_Split" name="Split: visa documents" gatewayDirection="Diverging">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_15</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_16</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_17</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_18</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_19</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_20</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_21</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_22</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_FillForm" name="Complete visa application form">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_16</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_23</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_TravelDocument" name="Provide travel document valid in Austria (validity exceeds visa duration by at least three months, at least two empty pages, issued within the last ten years)">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_17</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_24</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_PassportPhoto" name="Provide passport photo (portrait format, 35 x 45 mm, meeting photo criteria)">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_18</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_25</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_HealthInsurance" name="Provide comprehensive travel health insurance (cover 30,000 EUR, valid in Schengen area for entire stay)">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_19</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_26</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_Subsistence" name="Provide proof of sufficient means of subsistence (stay and return journey)">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_20</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_27</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_OtherEvidence" name="Provide other evidence requested by authorities">
      <bpmn:documentation>For example hotel reservations, invitations, booking confirmations, return flight ticket or proof of gainful employment. Evidence may vary by location; additional documents may be requested.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_21</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_28</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_NoRefusalGrounds" name="Confirm absence of other grounds for refusal (residence prohibition, Schengen alert)">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_22</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_29</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Docs_Join" name="Join: visa documents" gatewayDirection="Converging">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_23</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_24</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_25</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_26</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_27</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_28</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_29</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_30</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SubmitApplication" name="Submit visa application (Rot-Weiss-Rot Card) to competent representation">
      <bpmn:documentation>Visas are issued abroad by representation offices (BMEIA) or, in exceptional cases, by certain border control posts or the state police headquarters where extension is permitted. The Rot-Weiss-Rot Card visa must be renewed every x months.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_30</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_31</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_1" name="Visa application submitted">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_31</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_01" sourceRef="StartEvent_1" targetRef="Task_CheckRequirements"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_02" sourceRef="Task_CheckRequirements" targetRef="Gateway_Living_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_03" sourceRef="Gateway_Living_Split" targetRef="Task_Accommodation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_04" sourceRef="Gateway_Living_Split" targetRef="Task_BankAccount"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_05" sourceRef="Task_Accommodation" targetRef="Gateway_Living_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_06" sourceRef="Task_BankAccount" targetRef="Gateway_Living_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_07" sourceRef="Gateway_Living_Join" targetRef="Gateway_VisaType_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_08" name="Type D" sourceRef="Gateway_VisaType_Split" targetRef="Task_TypeD"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_09" name="Category A or C" sourceRef="Gateway_VisaType_Split" targetRef="Task_CategoryAC"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" name="Schengen" sourceRef="Gateway_VisaType_Split" targetRef="Task_Schengen"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="Task_TypeD" targetRef="Gateway_Office_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" sourceRef="Task_CategoryAC" targetRef="Gateway_Office_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" sourceRef="Task_Schengen" targetRef="Gateway_Office_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" sourceRef="Gateway_Office_Merge" targetRef="Task_ContactRepresentation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_15" sourceRef="Task_ContactRepresentation" targetRef="Gateway_Docs_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_16" sourceRef="Gateway_Docs_Split" targetRef="Task_FillForm"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_17" sourceRef="Gateway_Docs_Split" targetRef="Task_TravelDocument"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_18" sourceRef="Gateway_Docs_Split" targetRef="Task_PassportPhoto"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_19" sourceRef="Gateway_Docs_Split" targetRef="Task_HealthInsurance"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_20" sourceRef="Gateway_Docs_Split" targetRef="Task_Subsistence"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_21" sourceRef="Gateway_Docs_Split" targetRef="Task_OtherEvidence"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_22" sourceRef="Gateway_Docs_Split" targetRef="Task_NoRefusalGrounds"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_23" sourceRef="Task_FillForm" targetRef="Gateway_Docs_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_24" sourceRef="Task_TravelDocument" targetRef="Gateway_Docs_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_25" sourceRef="Task_PassportPhoto" targetRef="Gateway_Docs_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_26" sourceRef="Task_HealthInsurance" targetRef="Gateway_Docs_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_27" sourceRef="Task_Subsistence" targetRef="Gateway_Docs_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_28" sourceRef="Task_OtherEvidence" targetRef="Gateway_Docs_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_29" sourceRef="Task_NoRefusalGrounds" targetRef="Gateway_Docs_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_30" sourceRef="Gateway_Docs_Join" targetRef="Task_SubmitApplication"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_31" sourceRef="Task_SubmitApplication" targetRef="EndEvent_1"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
